excerpts:
News and Announcements | General Posted: February 27, 2026

Submit Nominations for the 2026 GALILEO Ambassador Award

Submit your nominations for the 2026 GALILEO Ambassador Award . The nominating period runs March 1-31.
It is a recognition program built to honor educators, librarians, library staff, or other history or literacy advocates across the state who go the extra mile to tout GALILEO and pursue lifelong learning opportunities in their schools, universities, or communities.
The GALILEO Ambassador Award is open to individuals representing any GALILEO-member institution in Georgia, as well as partner institutions. Institutions, as a whole, may also be nominated.
What is a GALILEO ambassador? These individuals help attract new virtual library users; build dynamic educational lessons incorporating GALILEO; promote history, literacy or library programs that integrate GALILEO; share content on social media that highlight classroom use; and discover new ways to highlight the resources provided by GALILEO, while embodying the GALILEO vision to facilitate lifelong learning for all Georgians.
Each year, at the GALILEO Annual Conference, a single individual or library/institution will be recognized with an award.
Visit the award webpage to submit your nominations and for additional information.

# Research and engineering under one roof

Patronus AI is a behavioral research lab for AI. We study how frontier models behave and investigate where they fail. We turn what we find into the training data that moves model capabilities forward.

A Patronus AI researcher at work during a day in Lyon

## Mission

Our mission is to deeply understand model failures. Not the cases where a model gets the answer wrong, but the ones where it technically finishes the task and does something no one wanted along the way. Tests rarely catch this type of failure. We build environments that surface them, then work out why they happen.

## Founders

Patronus AI was founded in 2023 by Anand Kannappan and Rebecca Qian. Our researchers and engineers come from Meta Superintelligence Labs, Amazon AGI, Apple and Google.

常见问题解答

AMD 大学计划是否是全球性的计划？

是的，AMD 大学计划服务于全球，其成员分布于世界各地，包括美洲、欧洲和亚洲。

要获得 AMD 大学计划提供的资源，应符合哪些条件？

AMD 大学计划非常自豪能够为学术和研究领域提供服务，对象包括教育工作者、研究人员和学生。

AMD 大学计划的主要愿景是什么？

AMD 大学计划致力于为学术界提供 AMD 技术支持，以增强教学和学习体验并推动领先的研究。​

当研究工作得到了 AMD 大学计划 (AUP) 项目的资助时，我该如何在出版物或公开材料中对 AUP 进行致谢？

请参阅我们的 《出版物及公开材料致谢指南》 。

AMD 大学计划 (AUP) 与 Xilinx 大学计划 (XUP) 和 AMD External Research Office (ERO) 之间有何关系？

AMD 大学计划 (AUP) 是 XUP 和 AMD ERO 的结合，为我们的学术客户提供服务。这个新页面从统一的角度介绍了该计划。
注意：虽然部分页面仍然引用旧版计划的内容，不过将很快整合到 AUP 中。

Stanford HAI has launched a new program for Stanford students that will allow them to work across disciplines to build ideas and community around AI that benefits humanity.
The HAI Student Affinity Groups will comprise students from all Stanford schools who share an interest in a topic related to human-centered AI. Groups may form around issues ranging from removing bias from data to rethinking the role of people in developing machine intelligence, considering the global societal impact of AI technolo

...

Stanford HAI will provide up to $500 in funding per term for each group for activities such as biweekly gatherings, space for meetings, and access to the institute’s community of researchers and fellows .
“Part of Stanford HAI's mission is to develop the next leaders of artificial intelligence,” says Vanessa Parli, HAI associate director of research programs. “Our goal through these affinity groups is to create a space for students to share ideas and develop a mindset where they question the human impact of building or using technology from the start.”
Applications are due Nov. 11, 2022. The first groups will be announced in mid-December and kick off during Winter quarter.

NYU、チャールズ・ツォ氏
原文を表示

よくある質問

アンバサダーには奨励金が支給されますか？

はい。選ばれたすべてのキャンパスアンバサダーには、プログラムの条件に応じて、3,600 米ドルの奨励金が支給されます。

これは Anthropic の公式プログラムですか？

はい。Claude Campus Ambassadors は、Anthropic が運営し、外部エージェンシーからのプログラムサポートを受けています。

誰が応募できますか？

世界中のどこにいる学生でも、どのプログラムにも応募できます。ただし、大学院および博士課程のプログラムでは、初期パイロット期間中、より限られた学校群から選抜する場合があります。プログラムに参加するには、18 歳以上であり、留学先での就労資格を有している必要があります。

応募のスケジュールはどうなっていますか？

出願は 9 月 1 日開始、9 月 12 日締め切りです。出願は順次審査いたします。

私は昨年、アンバサダーでした。 再申請する必要がありますか？

はい、必要です。昨年アンバサダーを務めた方は、フォームにてお知らせください。

参加に費用はかかりますか？

いいえ。申し込みも参加も無料です。

応募するには、Claude や AI に関する経験が必要ですか？

このプログラムでは、ある程度の AI リテラシーと Claude の習熟度を求めていますが、すべての分野の専門家である必要はありません。私たちがサポートいたします。PhD トラックでは、研究で Claude を積極的に活用している科学者を募集しています。

プログラムの期間はどのくらいですか？

これは、2026 年 9 月から 2027 年 6 月まで実施される学年を通じたプログラムです。

Gemini チーム
2026年 3月 18日
昨年の夏より約半年の間、学生の皆さんが Google Gemini をはじめとする AI ツールを最大限活用できるよう支援する「 Google AI 学生アンバサダー プログラム 」を開催しました。全国 200 以上の大学から約 800 名の学生が参加した本プログラムは、これからの時代を担う学生が AI を安全かつ効果的に活用するスキルを習得し、その知識を同世代へ広めることを支援するという目的のもと、様々な活動を行いました。その中でも 1000 を超える Gemini 活用のアイデアから抜粋して制作した「 Gemini 活用事例集」 など、学生ならではの多種多様な AI 活用術を発信しました。
本日より、すべての大学生および大学院生の方に、昨年の Google AI 学生 アンバサダープログラムの主なアイデア交流の場であった「 Google AI 学生コミュニティ 」へ登録いただけるようになりました。学部や学年、地域の垣根を越え、全国の学生同士でつながり、Gemini などの生成 AI ツールを賢く活用するアイデアを交換し、学生自身の可能性を広げるための機会を提供することを目的としています。参加を希望される学生は、 ご登録 ください。
さらに、Gemini と共に学び、学生生活に進化をもたらす1 年間にわたるプログラム「 キャンパスアンバサダー 」に参加する大学生および大学院生を約 15 名募集します。本プログラムでは、 Google AI を活用し Gemini のマーケティングチームとともに、大学生活がより充実したものになるようキャンパスで活動します。選考プロセスを経てアンバサダーに確定された学生は、4 月より開始するプログラムにご参加いただきます。ご関心のある学生の皆様は、ぜひ 応募フォーム よりお申し込みください（募集締め切り 4 月 12日 23:59 時)。

excerpts:
A practical path to joining a tech ambassador program: proof of contribution, fit, and how to use this directory to apply.
By Davide Carlomagno · Updated 2026-07-25

Build proof before you apply

Most selective programs look for evidence you already help others: tutorials, talks, open-source help, meetup organizing, or consistent community answers.
You do not need a huge audience. You need a credible trail of contribution in the product’s ecosystem.

Match fit, not just brand prestige

Filter the directory by category, region, and perks. Read requirements on each program page. Apply where your skills and time match the ask—volume applications to mismatched programs waste everyone’s time.

Application basics that help

When a form asks why you want in, be specific:
* What you have already shipped or taught with their product
* Who you can help (audience, region, language)
* How you will contribute in the first 90 days

Announcing the Postman Student Leader Program

Announcing the Postman Student Leader Program

User Avatar
Mei’lani Eyre
April 29, 2021
Six months ago, we started building the Postman Student Expert training program to educate students and improve their API literacy through a self-paced curriculum created by the Postman team. Since then, we’ve welcomed thousands of bright students from across the globe into our student community and certified hundreds of outstanding Postman Student Experts. Now, for the Postman Student Experts who want to go the extra mile to use their knowledge and help educate their peers, we’re thrilled to launch the Postman Student Leader program . This program will provide students hands-on experience with public speaking, event planning, and teaching API skills—all so that they can make a greater impact on their campus.
The Postman Student Leader program allows students to take the next step after earning their Postman Student Expert badge. It further empowers them to become a leader on their campus promoting API literacy amongst their peers.
Official Postman Student Leaders receive:
* Access to Postman resources to organize events on their campus
* Postman Student Leader Badge
* Opportunities to speak and participate in Postman events

...

How to apply to the Docker Captains program in 2026. What they ask, what you get, and the official application page.

By [Davide Carlomagno](https://ambassador.directory/about) · Updated 2026-09-02

## Apply on Docker's site

The Docker Captains program is open internationally. Apply on Docker's official page.

...

## What they ask

You must be 18 or older. The program is open internationally. You also need to abide by the Docker Community Code of Conduct.

Official eligibility: technical expertise in Docker and related tech, active community involvement and thought leadership, valuable product feedback, a strong online presence with a significant audience or following, and a history of significant Docker community contributions.

The listing on this site asks for deep Docker expertise, active community contributions, content creation and knowledge sharing, and OSS contributions to the Docker ecosystem.

...

* Docker Thought Leader: you show influence online. Official bar: at least 5,000 monthly views across blogs, social, or other online channels.
* Docker Community Contributor: you have already helped the community through content, events, or open source. Official bar: 5+ years of community leadership or helping people online.

results.title: Docker Captains |
excerpts:
Docker Captains

A dedicated space for Docker Captains’ Projects, Resources and Newsfeeds.
My Image
Docker Captain is a distinction that Docker awards select members of the community that are both experts in their field and are passionate about sharing their Docker knowledge with others. Captains are Docker ambassadors (not employees) and their commitment to sharing their expertise has a huge impact on the Docker community – whether they are blogging, writing books, speaking, running workshops, creating tutorials and classes, offering support in forums, or organizing and contributing to local events – they help make Docker’s mission of democratizing technology possible.
This program is designed to foster Docker advocates and promote the creation of high-value content by connecting program members with Docker engineering and marketing resources. Program participants will be established as high-profile community leaders to inspire and educate the Docker community.
Membership into this program is based on:
* Recommendation by Docker employee
* Demonstrated competence in Docker technology
* Being a positive presence in the tech community and ecosystem
Benefits of the Docker Captains program include:
* Briefings prior to product updates and other announcements with Docker engineers and special guests
* Ability to list program membership on personal profiles
* Promotion of relevant content created by members through Docker’s social channels

How to apply to an LFX Mentorship program, what the prerequisites are, and what happens next.
Applying happens in LFX, the Linux Foundation's software platform. This site is where you find the program; the application itself is at app.lfx.dev .

Before you begin

* You need a mentee profile. See Become a Mentee .
* You may have at most three open applications at a time. Withdrawing one frees a slot.
* Check the program's prerequisites on its page first — several ask for a resume, a cover letter on set topics, a coding challenge, or school enrollment verification.
* Check Applications close in the program sidebar.

Steps

1. Open the program you want from Find a Program .
2. Select Apply to This Program . You are taken to LFX and asked to sign in.
3. Confirm you meet the program's eligibility checks.
4. Complete each prerequisite the program requires.
5. Acknowledge the program terms and the compliance confirmation.
6. Submit the application.

After completing

Your application appears in your mentee overview at app.lfx.dev/mentorship/mentee , and the program's mentors review it against the skills the program listed and what you wrote.
* Outcome | What it means
* Pending | Submitted and waiting for the Program Admins' decision
* Accepted | You have a place on the term; your tasks appear in LFX

excerpts:
Documentation Index

Fetch the complete documentation index at: https://docs.granola.ai/llms.txt Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

Affiliate program

Learn how to apply to the Granola Affiliate Program.

How to apply

You can apply to join the Granola Affiliate Program here.

Why was my application rejected?

We're a small team and have to be selective about where we focus. A few common reasons applications may be declined:
* The application was incomplete or missing key details
* The contact email didn't match the information provided on your business or social profiles
* There wasn't a strong fit between your promotional approach and our current campaign priorities
* You're based in a region we're not currently focusing marketing effort on
You're welcome to reapply in the future if your content or audience evolves. We review new applications regularly. Unfortunately, we're not able to send individual feedback on applications.

Affiliate program vs. referral program

The affiliate program is separate from Granola's referral program. The referral program lets Granola users share a unique link to give new users 2 months of Granola Business.

This isn't just a title. Ambassadors receive training, mentorship, and support to develop real skills in community building, event planning, and leadership.

Key Activities:

* Host campus events (workshops, panels, meetups)
* Recruit new members and grow local presence
* Share opportunities and resources with peers
* Represent Campus Collab at external events
* Provide feedback and ideas to the core team
